compute.basis: Requires OpenAI API calls for ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo) and Google search API; no GPU needed but API costs and rate limits dominate; 500 examples with up to 3 correction rounds and 7 search interactions each.

title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
